objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the JMXInvokerServlet deserialization to run commands on JBoss and read /ctf/flag.
hints: /invoker/JMXInvokerServlet accepts serialised Java objects over HTTP and deserialises them.
Look at the libraries in JBoss AS 6.1.0's lib directory. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Identify the product
steps.prompt: Which version of JBoss AS does the server run? (number only)

steps.title: Find the entry point
steps.prompt: Which servlet path is the entry point? (path)

steps.title: Name the service
steps.prompt: Which management technology does that servlet front? (acronym)
